title: Narecho
summary: Raleigh names Narecho in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Narecho, the name which Cedrenus giues to that Pharao who held the Crowne fiftie yeeres, and from whom the surname of Pharao passed to a long posteritie. Pharao is kept on his owne record. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
